scope: MEAS: independent source/order, bar map, gate arithmetic, fresh overlays and audio features (chroma transposition and lag tests, per-bar shift scan, vocal-range pitch ranking and traces, pitch-band onsets, audio-to-audio DTW against the other two Beach recordings); not aural review.

observations.finding: This is non-blocking; bar boundaries are unaffected. Inside the held D-flat harmony of bars 26–27 the piano's repeated triplet chords are unevenly spaced. Attacks fall at 45.428/45.446 s and 47.222/47.229/47.235 s, 6–18 ms apart. Bars 26 (45.16 s, constrained), 28 (47.492 s; D-flat5 band rise 47.52 s) and 29 (48.676 s) are measured.

These are documentation only. The REPORT's 'fresh 38–51 and 40–52 s overlays' were written at 04:47:20 and 04:45:29, before this publication's config (04:47:55) and results (04:48:10). The published candidate's own overlays are 41.16–53.16 and 44.68–55.07 s. The REPORT also asks the module owner to correct the order claim, but content/listen/beach-years-at-the-spring-eames-1908.mjs already states that Eames sings both settings.

report.finding: The section matches results and checks: windows first [0.16, 0.22] and last [48.6, 49.3] measuring 48.676 s, the q77.112 constraint at 45.16 s, gates and score SHA-256 43bd38ef…a179. Config SHA-256 891868c6… equals results.configSha256; the work candidate equals the public score; checks equal results; the pinned lc6212179.mxl and the cached audio match their SHA-256 values.

barMap.finding: All 995 notes lie inside their bar; bar times strictly increase; the first attack (the grace) is at 0.16 s and the last written hold ends at the −45 dB end, 50.18 s. Sheet and note/bar identities are identical to the Eames 1905 publication, whose rasterised page was inspected.

order.finding: The complete first setting is sung, so all 29 bars in written order is correct. The vocal-range trace gives D-flat5 'year's' 0.9–1.3 s, B-flat4 2.5–2.9 s, E-flat5 'day's' 4.0–4.4 s, C5 'morn' 5.2–5.8 s, F5 'Morn-' 6.8–7.0 s, D-flat5 'sev-en' about 8.0–8.6 s, G-flat5 'hill-' 9.3–10.3 s and the E-flat5 'pearled' hold 11.9–14.6 s. The second setting's repeated A-flat4 follows from 15.8 s (bar 10 at 15.240 s). Audio-to-audio DTW from the Eames 1905 map places bars 2–9 of that recording within −0.34 to +0.70 s of this map's bars 2–9.

independentChecks.tuningAndKey: librosa estimate −0.120 semitone = 436.96 Hz, equal to the published tuningHz. Chroma rotation gives 0.745 at the written key, against ≤0.389 at ±1–3 semitones, so the recording is in D-flat as encoded.
independentChecks.lag: Global lag peaks at 0 s (0.745, against 0.691/0.705 at ∓0.25 s). In the per-bar scan 19 of 29 bars fit best within 0.3 s. Most others gain under 0.1 in cosine on held notes (bars 19–23: F5/G-flat5/A-flat5 holds) or in the unchanged D-flat ending. Only bars 22 (+0.9 s) and 29 (−1.8 s) clear that threshold; the traces and band rises below contradict both.
independentChecks.voice: The written vocal pitch ranks first for 40 of 58 sung notes and in the top three for 48; shifting the line by one note gives 16 or 19 firsts. Traces put G-flat5 'heaven' at 33.4–33.6 s (bar 21 at 33.403 s), the A-flat5 'right' hold from about 35.3 s (bar 22 at 35.127 s), G-flat5 'All's' at 39.9–40.4 s (40.055 s) and E-flat5 at 41.1 s (bar 25 at 40.894 s).
independentChecks.endpoints: The bar-1 chord rises right after the grace placement (fresh 0–8.16 s overlay). D-flat5 'world' rises at 45.09–45.22 s against the constrained 45.16 s; the final chord's D-flat6/F6/D-flat7 band rises 10.9 dB at 48.67 s (bar 29 at 48.676 s). The ending is faster than in the other two recordings (bars 26–28 last 3.5 s, against 6.2 s for Eames 1905). The voice and band measurements support it.
independentChecks.crossRecording: Audio-to-audio DTW from this map into the Gadski recording agrees with Gadski's independently published bar times within ±0.35 s for all of bars 1–26. Bars 27–29 collapse in every DTW pair under the held D-flat harmony and were checked by pitch bands instead.

overlays.finding: Both are in the results' fresh list. They show the grace placed before the chord rise; bars 26–29 bracketed by the D-flat5 entry, the bar-28 chord and the final chord; and the written hold ending at the decay.
